description: This file declares the SharedMemoryHandle class, which implements the ISharedMemoryHandle interface for managing shared memory in the Rialto client component. It includes constructor, destructor, and a method to access the shared memory buffer, along with private members for file descriptor, buffer length, and buffer pointer.

classes.name: SharedMemoryHandle
classes.description: A class that manages shared memory resources, including file descriptor, buffer length, and buffer pointer, implementing the ISharedMemoryHandle interface.

methods.name: SharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shared memory handle with a file descriptor and buffer length.

methods.name: ~SharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the shared memory handle.

methods.name: getShm
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the shared memory buffer.
